exclusionProof.note: Bounded known-only witness search. Unknown reveals stop the hypothetical route; their actual faces are never sampled from the real board. Optional public-geometry exposure values newly readable fields without querying them; already known physical continuations remain searchable, and actual observations occur after every tap. Clock distance is an ordering heuristic, not a proven bound. A knownDead certificate requires a fully exhausted known graph with no new information or unsupported transition, pruning only separately certified losses. Excluded heuristic roots require a separate bounded search sharing the remaining node budget before a death certificate; it chooses an actual losing/progressing tap rather than calling a computation cap a failure. A returned win/exit has a constructive physical witness; other absence is not a proof of loss, uniqueness or optimality. Automatic Joker transitions outside the public transition model remain unresolved.
